name: Sigrun
title: Waykeeper of the Timber Road
examine: The lamp on her shoulder is the Waykeepers' and the mud on her boots is the Timber Road's. She has opinions about which of the two ways here you took.
lines: Came up the Sparway, did you. I can always tell. You have the face for it.
Two lamps on the Timber Road and a hamlet at the turn. That took the Waykeepers nine years to argue for.
The long road is longer. That is the entire point of the long road.
